title: Lotusroot Gratin with Jammy Onions
description: A rich and creamy gratin dish featuring lotusroot and caramelized jammy onions.
instructions: Peel and slice lotusroot into 1/4 inch thick rounds.
Melt 2 tablespoons of luscious butter in a pan over medium heat.
Add sliced jammy onions and cook until caramelized, stirring occasionally.
In a separate pan, melt the remaining 2 tablespoons of luscious butter over medium heat.
Add sliced lotusroot and cook until golden brown, stirring occasionally.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of lotusroot slices.
Top with a layer of caramelized jammy onions, followed by a layer of dutch cheese.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 35-40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the gratin is heated through.
